text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #263746

g.text: 四个案例：对照原先冻结的预期

text.style: font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #62727c

g.text: 预期完成程度 → 实际完成程度；保留历史结果

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.35px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0072b2
font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746

g.text: 重建系统后取回旧错因，

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.35px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #009e73
font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746

g.text: 新学生不读取他人记录，

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.35px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #e69f00
font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746

g.text: 程序可执行，但改错位置：

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746

g.text: 改累计值，而非补齐列表。

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.35px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #263746
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #e69f00
font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746

g.text: 空输出正确，却把有效空预测

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; fill: #263746
font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #62727c

g.text: 成功来源是工具、模板与记忆，不代表模型协作能力得到提升。

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #62727c

g.text: C07 仍保留“预期局限”标签；没有改标签来凑案例。
